title: Architecture: Vietnamese Pharma Stock Forecasting
description: Comparative stock price forecasting pipeline for 3 Vietnamese pharmaceutical companies (AMV, DHT, DP3) using 8 models spanning statistical, ML, and deep learning with temporal train-test splits across 30/60/90-day horizons.

nodes.label: Investing.com Data
nodes.description: Historical OHLCV data for AMV (1,313), DHT (1,312), DP3 (1,137) from Mar 2019 - May 2024

nodes.label: Data Preparation
nodes.description: Temporal sorting, MinMaxScaler normalization, lookback window creation (time_step=30 for LSTM/RNN, 100 for GRU)

nodes.label: Statistical Models
nodes.description: Linear Regression, LR with Calendar Fourier + DeterministicProcess, FFT frequency decomposition

nodes.label: ML Models
nodes.description: ARIMA (auto-selected via pmdarima), LightGBM hybrid (LSTM predictions + OHLC features)

nodes.label: Deep Learning Models
nodes.description: 3-layer stacked LSTM (50 units), single-layer GRU, 4-layer SimpleRNN with dropout

nodes.label: Evaluation Framework
nodes.description: RMSE, MAPE, MSLE across 72 configurations (8 models x 3 companies x 3 splits)

nodes.label: Jupyter Notebooks
nodes.description: 42 notebooks (32 model + 6 lab + 4 class examples) with visualizations

nodes.label: IEEE OJIES Report
nodes.description: 957-line LaTeX report with 113 figures and 87 bibliography references
